fixed_versions: For Red Hat Lightspeed in Satellite installation see the Red Hat Satellite documentation.
mitigations: There is no practical mitigation for this vulnerability. The brace-expansion package is typically a transitive dependency pulled in via minimatch and glob, making it difficult to isolate. Users should upgrade to a fixed version of brace-expansion when one becomes available.
